+"""Standalone source availability probe.
+
+This module intentionally depends only on the standard library so it can be
+loaded by file path without importing ``_pytest`` or running its
+initialization.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import inspect
+from typing import TypedDict
+
+
+__all__ = ["SourceStatus", "vendored_source_status_variant"]
+
+
+class SourceStatus(TypedDict):
+    available: bool
+    line_count: int
+
+
+def vendored_source_status_variant(obj: object) -> SourceStatus:
+    """Report whether source code for ``obj`` can be retrieved.
+
+    Returns ``{"available": True, "line_count": n}`` with the number of source
+    lines reported by :func:`inspect.getsourcelines`. If the source cannot be
+    retrieved (:class:`OSError` or :class:`TypeError`), returns
+    ``{"available": False, "line_count": 0}``. Any other exception propagates.
+    """
+    try:
+        lines, _ = inspect.getsourcelines(obj)  # type: ignore[arg-type]
+    except (OSError, TypeError):
+        return {"available": False, "line_count": 0}
+    return {"available": True, "line_count": len(lines)}

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import importlib.util
+import inspect
+from pathlib import Path
+import sys
+import types
+from unittest import mock
+
+import pytest
+
+
+MODULE_PATH = Path(__file__).parents[2] / "src" / "standalone_wave6_source_status.py"
+
+
+def _load_module() -> types.ModuleType:
+    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(
+        "standalone_wave6_source_status", MODULE_PATH
+    )
+    assert spec is not None and spec.loader is not None
+    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
+    return module
+
+
+mod = _load_module()
+status = mod.vendored_source_status_variant
+
+
+def _sample(x):
+    y = x + 1
+    return y
+
+
+def test_function_with_source() -> None:
+    expected = len(inspect.getsourcelines(_sample)[0])
+    result = status(_sample)
+    assert result == {"available": True, "line_count": expected}
+    assert result["line_count"] == 3
+
+
+def test_class_with_source() -> None:
+    class Local:
+        a = 1
+
+    assert status(Local) == {"available": True, "line_count": 2}
+
+
+def test_result_is_plain_dict() -> None:
+    result = status(_sample)
+    assert type(result) is dict
+    assert set(result) == {"available", "line_count"}
+    assert isinstance(result["available"], bool)
+    assert isinstance(result["line_count"], int)
+
+
+def test_empty_source_lines() -> None:
+    with mock.patch.object(inspect, "getsourcelines", return_value=([], 0)):
+        assert status(_sample) == {"available": True, "line_count": 0}
+
+
+def test_builtin_is_unavailable() -> None:
+    assert status(len) == {"available": False, "line_count": 0}
+
+
+def test_non_source_object_is_unavailable() -> None:
+    assert status(42) == {"available": False, "line_count": 0}
+
+
+def test_dynamically_compiled_code_is_unavailable() -> None:
+    namespace: dict[str, object] = {}
+    exec(compile("def f():\n    pass\n", "<dynamic>", "exec"), namespace)
+    assert status(namespace["f"]) == {"available": False, "line_count": 0}
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("exc", [OSError("no source"), TypeError("bad object")])
+def test_expected_errors_are_unavailable(exc: Exception) -> None:
+    with mock.patch.object(inspect, "getsourcelines", side_effect=exc):
+        assert status(_sample) == {"available": False, "line_count": 0}
+
+
+def test_runtime_error_propagates() -> None:
+    # Unlike a broad ``except Exception``, unexpected errors are not suppressed.
+    with mock.patch.object(inspect, "getsourcelines", side_effect=RuntimeError("boom")):
+        with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="boom"):
+            status(_sample)
+
+
+def test_uses_getsourcelines_not_findsource() -> None:
+    with mock.patch.object(inspect, "findsource", side_effect=AssertionError):
+        with mock.patch.object(
+            inspect, "getsourcelines", return_value=(["a\n", "b\n"], 10)
+        ):
+            assert status(_sample) == {"available": True, "line_count": 2}
+
+
+def test_no_dependency_on_pytest_code_source() -> None:
+    source = MODULE_PATH.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+    assert "_pytest" not in source.replace("``_pytest``", "")
+    for name in ("Source", "findsource"):
+        assert not hasattr(mod, name)
+
+
+def test_importable_without_pytest_package(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
+    import subprocess
+
+    code = (
+        "import importlib.util, sys\n"
+        f"spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('m', {str(MODULE_PATH)!r})\n"
+        "m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)\n"
+        "spec.loader.exec_module(m)\n"
+        "assert not any(k == '_pytest' or k.startswith('_pytest.') for k in sys.modules)\n"
+        "print(m.vendored_source_status_variant(len))\n"
+    )
+    out = subprocess.run(
+        [sys.executable, "-I", "-c", code],
+        cwd=tmp_path,
+        capture_output=True,
+        text=True,
+        check=True,
+    )
+    assert out.stdout.strip() == "{'available': False, 'line_count': 0}"
